content.short: Decentralised community NFT collection of 10K Punkz restructured with unique traits and attributes inspired by the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description: In 2017, the world saw for the first time what is now one of the biggest NFT projects and back then, it was only a few enthusiasts who could get their hands on Punk. 4 years later, Punks are being sold for millions of USD. In ADAPunks, we are committed to give the Cardano community the chance to own their own Punk. To ensure that everyone has the same opportunity to get a rare ADAPunk, the purchase will be made on a random basis, so buyers will only be able to see their ADAPunk on their wallet (Nami/Yoroi/Daedalus) after purchasing it. There is no Punks limit per wallet, so you can buy as many as you want, but once the 10,000 are minted it’ll be too late to get one at mint cost.
